slices.focus: Nathaniel and Erin's belated anniversary weekend in Hocking Hills reveals the need to protect one no-work evening per week.
slices.summary: After postponing twice, Nathaniel and Erin finally take a short cabin weekend in Hocking Hills. The trip reveals how much work has been bleeding into home life, and they agree to protect one no-work evening (Wednesday) with no email, no laptop, and explicit rescheduling if moved.
